description: Isolated systems cost of scoring the recorded-public-L2 model-contract artefact through the optional ONNX Runtime backend. This is an inference-latency diagnostic, not the trading hot path.

python_reference.description: Comparison run through the Python onnxruntime package on the same machine, reported for context. The C++ row above is the in-process cost through the project's own optional backend.

scope: Model load is measured separately and is not folded into per-call latency.
Steady-state inference performs about two allocations per call from ONNX Runtime per-run buffers.
Timings are local to the disclosed host and are not portable.

provenance.note: Values are transcribed unchanged from the 2026-06-04 benchmark record. They were not recomputed for this repository.
